mood: Modern, colorful, fun, warm, approachable, confident, and distinctly local without being kitschy.

typography.font_pairings_rationale: Outfit provides geometric modernity with a friendly, bold edge. Figtree ensures highly legible, approachable body text.
typography.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tight text-[#111111]

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: p-4, p-6, p-8, p-12 (Generous padding to give content breathing room)
layout_and_spacing.border_radius: rounded-2xl (Soft inner curves offset by hard outer borders)
layout_and_spacing.grid_system_landing: Bento Grid Mode A (Tetris) - Assymetrical layout with thick borders and solid color blocks
layout_and_spacing.grid_system_dashboard: Control Room layout with structured widgets featuring neo-brutalist shadows

surfaces_and_components.cards: bg-white border-2 border-[#111111] rounded-2xl shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(17,17,17,1)] hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-[6px_6px_0px_0px_rgba(17,17,17,1)] transition-all duration-200
surfaces_and_components.buttons_primary: bg-[#FFD500] text-[#111111] border-2 border-[#111111] rounded-xl px-6 py-3 shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(17,17,17,1)] hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:shadow-[6px_6px_0px_0px_rgba(17,17,17,1)] active:translate-y-1 active:shadow-none transition-all
surfaces_and_components.buttons_secondary: bg-[#38B6FF] text-[#111111] border-2 border-[#111111] rounded-xl px-6 py-3 shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(17,17,17,1)] hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:shadow-[6px_6px_0px_0px_rgba(17,17,17,1)] active:translate-y-1 active:shadow-none transition-all
surfaces_and_components.header: Solid background bg-[#FFFDF9] border-b-2 border-[#111111] z-50 sticky top-0 px-6 py-4
surfaces_and_components.inputs: bg-white border-2 border-[#111111] rounded-xl px-4 py-3 focus:outline-none focus:ring-4 focus:ring-[#FFD500]/50 text-[#111111]
surfaces_and_components.chat_bubble_user: bg-[#38B6FF] text-[#111111] border-2 border-[#111111] rounded-2xl rounded-tr-sm p-4 shadow-[2px_2px_0px_0px_rgba(17,17,17,1)]
surfaces_and_components.chat_bubble_ai: bg-white text-[#111111] border-2 border-[#111111] rounded-2xl rounded-tl-sm p-4 shadow-[2px_2px_0px_0px_rgba(17,17,17,1)]
surfaces_and_components.badges: inline-block bg-[#FF5757] text-white border-2 border-[#111111] rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-sm font-bold shadow-[2px_2px_0px_0px_rgba(17,17,17,1)]

motion_and_interactions.hover: Translate Y up slightly (-translate-y-1) and increase shadow depth.
motion_and_interactions.active: Translate down (translate-y-1) and remove shadow to simulate pressing a tactile button.

accessibility.contrast_strategy: High contrast enforced via black borders and strong text colors.
accessibility.focus_states: Thick focus rings using primary color to support keyboard navigation.

iconography_and_imagery.icon_library: lucide-react (Use strokeWidth={2.5} or {3} for a punchier, chunkier look matching the heavy borders)
iconography_and_imagery.image_strategy: Vibrant, friendly lifestyle imagery representing Quebec youth, framed with solid black borders. Avoid generic tech illustrations.

image_urls.description: Group of friends at a coffee shop, used for the landing page hero section.
Montreal skyline at sunset. Good for the community or dashboard header background.
Abstract colorful geometric pattern. Useful for guide covers, empty states, or abstract accents.

sections: Hero: Giant typography ('Allô Québec'), bright yellow CTA ('Commencer'), offset image of young adults with a thick black border.
Value Prop: 3 bento box cards explaining AI Chat, Reminders/Deadlines, and Guides.
Social Proof/Footer: Simple thick-bordered footer with large brand text.

ai_chat.layout: Full height minus header. Wide, centered chat container. Input box at the bottom must have thick border and a distinct send button.

dashboard.layout: Control room style bento grid. Widgets: Next deadline (e.g., SAAQ), Recent Chats, Quick Guide Links.

guides_library.layout: Grid of playful cards with bright abstract covers or icons, featuring bold titles (RAMQ, Taxes, GAMF).

guide_detail.layout: Narrow, readable reading column. Large bold title, step-by-step checklist with custom checkbox styling (thick borders).

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and configure 'Outfit' (headings) and 'Figtree' (body) via Google Fonts.
Implement Neo-Brutalist shadow utilities in tailwind.config.js (e.g., shadow-brutal: '4px 4px 0px 0px rgba(17,17,17,1)').
Apply hover and active state transitions to ALL buttons and clickable cards.
Do NOT use any generic SaaS purple or soft, muddy gradients. Stick to the defined bright, solid colors.
Use lucide-react for icons, ensuring a heavier stroke width (2.5 or 3).
Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements for robust testing.
